bundle.shortDescription: 3D PBR texture painting for humans and AI agents
bundle.longDescription: Patina paints physically based materials onto 3D meshes: layers, smart materials, generator masks driven by baked curvature and occlusion, and brush strokes stored in 3D. Every tool is a command that AI agents can run through MCP, live in the window or headless. Exports glTF, Unreal, Unity and generic texture sets, and GLB.
